Topic 3.2: Reading readiness skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading readiness skills. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: when (2HRS) a) Demonstrate left-right eye and drop from left to right in a digital clip. reading?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Demonstrate top-down activity and guided to turn pages from right to left. turn pages orientation skills when reading. •

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING READINESS SKILLS
This lesson teaches Reading readiness skills for PP1 LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. Demonstrate top-down activity and guided to turn pages from right to left. turn pages orientation skills when reading. •
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading readiness skills using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading readiness skills above.
2. Explain Reading readiness skills to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading readiness skills.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading readiness skills with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading readiness skills important for a PP1 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT
